hook: Harvey flooded this house to the roof. They were still there.
narration: Floodwater had swallowed this house up to the roof, and people were still waiting beside it.
This was Beaumont, Texas, after Hurricane Harvey, on August 30, 2017.
A Navy helicopter crew from squadron HSC 7 came in overhead.
They lowered a rescue swimmer on the cable, down into the water by the boat.
The swimmer loads one person at a time into a rescue basket, and the hoist operator reels it up.
[short pause] One by one, they rode the basket up into the cabin.
Together with HSC 28, this squadron had made more than two hundred twenty rescues in Texas.
outcome: The crew flew the survivors out of the flood and set them down on dry pavement.
title: Harvey flooded their house to the roof
description:
On Aug. 30, 2017, a U.S. Navy Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron 7 crew hoisted people from a flooded home in Beaumont, Texas, after Hurricane Harvey.
